title: The coefficient-presentation scalar square normalized on abelian sheaves
statement: Let B,Bprime,R,S be commutative rings, q:B→Bprime, b:R→B, bprime:S→Bprime and r:R→S satisfy bprime∘r=q∘b. Let J and α,β,a satisfy the locally bijective presentation assumptions of def-weil-pbc-coefficient-sheafification-iso. Realize fixed-ring sheaves by restricting b or bprime, passing to constant-ring module presheaves, and module sheafifying along α or β. There is a canonical natural isomorphism Res_q⋙Real_α≅Real_β⋙Res_a. Its underlying abelian-sheaf components are identities.

source.place: The module-sheafification adjunction, its forgetful hom-equivalence formulas and unit; the scalar-composition isomorphism of ModuleCat.

proof.text: The two restrictions on module presheaves are canonically isomorphic by ModuleCat.restrictScalarsCompApp and bprime∘r=q∘b; all component maps are identities on elements. Whisker that presheaf isomorphism with α-sheafification and paste it with rawIso, using the associators. After forgetting, rawIso is the identity and the presheaf restriction isomorphism is the identity, so the resulting map is the abelian sheafification functor applied to an identity.
